column1: # The constitution already says editing engine/harness/lib or a hook is
# adversarial: those run in every session of every governed project, and a
# mistake there is silent. This is that sentence made mechanical, so felix
# classify and felix scope work on Felix the way they work on everything else.

column4: runs in every session of every governed project
decides which hooks run at all; a bad edit here silently disables every enforcement Felix has
sourced by the CLI and by every hook
the version here decides whether anything deploys at all
CI is the only judge that is not the model
the CLI surface; wrong here is loud rather than silent
seeds every new project, but only at creation
a gate that cannot fail is not a gate
weakening the suite is how a gate stops being one
changes what gets suggested, not what runs
a record of when upkeep ran
